author: Bapak Alex
attribution: Photo: Bapak Alex, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Shop_in_Dhangethi.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Small bilingual name plate above the shop window of a souvenir shop, Dhangethi; the plate is only about 120 px wide. A small Thaana line above 'WHITE STONE' (presumably the same name) is too small to transcribe reliably and is left out. A tiny unit tag 'G-09' is beside the door. T-shirts printed 'MALDIVES' are distractors. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Shahee Ilyas
attribution: Photo: Shahee Ilyas, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Old_Cafe_Near_Bis_Buru_Maafannu_(133468297).jpeg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Faded red letters on a white board over an old café, Maafannu, Malé. 'BALAKSHAAN' and 'CAFE' are run together with no space (CAFE is smaller). The Thaana line has a second word to the left (probably 'café') whose vowel marks are not clear enough to transcribe, so only the first word is given. Election posters and 'FOUNDATION IN BUSINESS' flyers on the boarded door are distractors; scooter number plates are incidental. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Unilandofma
attribution: Photo: Unilandofma, CC0 1.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Aminiya_School_sign_2024.jpg. License: http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.en. Unmodified original.
notes: Raised white letters on a green boundary wall, Malé, slightly from below with leaf shadows. The English name is in a blackletter font. The motto 'Serve One Another' below is partly hidden by shrubs and is left out of lines.

author: otterboris
attribution: Photo: otterboris, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:KURUMBA_ISLAND_WELCOME_SIGN_5_-_panoramio.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Frosted-glass resort name plate with a leaf logo mounted on a stone boulder (Kurumba resort, North Malé Atoll). The yellow '19 2 2011' at bottom right is a camera date stamp, not part of the sign. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Saaremees
attribution: Photo: Saaremees, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Dhiffushi_Sign-Maldives-Andres_Larin.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Large free-standing white 3D letters of the island name sign on Dhiffushi, Kaafu Atoll ('K' is the atoll code). A tourist poses behind the letters between 'I' and 'F' (face small, sunglasses) and does not hide any letter.

author: Saaremees
attribution: Photo: Saaremees, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Maafushi_Sign-Maldives-Andres_Larin.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Large white 3D letters of the island name sign on Maafushi beach (Kaafu Atoll), shot wide-angle with whale-shark and ray sculptures on top. Parked scooters behind are incidental.
